# Generated by tools/build_duels.py.
ac_challenge_duel_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_hostile
	common_interaction = yes
	icon = icon_combat
	desc = ac_challenge_duel_interaction_desc
	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 2 }

	send_option = { flag = ac_duel_lethal localization = ac_duel_lethal_option }
	send_options_exclusive = no

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { is_adult = yes }
		scope:recipient = { is_adult = yes NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		OR = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ac_cultivator } scope:recipient = { has_trait = ac_cultivator } }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no NOT = { has_variable = ac_duel_foe } }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no NOT = { has_variable = ac_duel_foe } }
	}

	ai_accept = {
		base = -10
		modifier = { add = 30 scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } desc = ac_duel_ai_brave_reason }
		modifier = { add = -40 scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } desc = ac_duel_ai_craven_reason }
		modifier = { add = 20 scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } desc = ac_duel_ai_wrathful_reason }
		modifier = { add = 25 scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } desc = AI_RIVAL_REASON }
		modifier = { add = 25 scope:recipient = { prowess > scope:actor.prowess } desc = ac_duel_ai_stronger_reason }
		modifier = { add = -30 scope:recipient = { prowess < scope:actor.prowess } desc = ac_duel_ai_weaker_reason }
		modifier = { add = -50 scope:ac_duel_lethal = yes desc = ac_duel_ai_lethal_reason }
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_foe }
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_duel_lethal = yes } ac_duel_start_effect = { LETHAL = yes } }
			else = { ac_duel_start_effect = { LETHAL = no } }
		}
	}
	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = { add_prestige = 25 }
		scope:recipient = { add_prestige = -25 }
	}

	ai_targets = { ai_recipients = rivals }
	ai_frequency = 24
	ai_potential = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_trait = craven } }
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = { add = 15 has_trait = wrathful }
		modifier = { add = 15 has_trait = brave }
		modifier = { add = 10 has_relation_rival = scope:recipient }
	}
}
